items.name: bento-2
items.description: A 2x2 equal-tile bento grid with centered heading, where each tile has a square icon, a badge category label, a title, and a one-line description. All four tiles are identical in size.

items.name: how-it-works-2
items.description: A vertical left-rail timeline that stacks four numbered steps down the page, each with a bordered icon circle, a connecting line to the next step, a monospaced step counter, a bold title, and a line of supporting copy.

items.name: newsletter-2
items.description: A full-width horizontal band on a bg-muted panel with branding label, heading, and subtext on the left, and an inline email input plus subscribe button with a privacy note on the right.

items.name: announcement-2
items.description: A centered card-style product-update callout featuring a "New" badge with version label, a bold feature headline, a supporting detail sentence, release metadata, and a primary CTA button. A focused announcement panel distinct from the dismissible top-bar variant.

items.name: blog-2
items.description: A minimal blog post list showing five articles as divider-separated rows, each with category badge, date, title, excerpt, author avatar with name, and a ghost "Read more" button. No cards or cover images.

items.name: team-2
items.description: A centered single row of five team members, each showing a large avatar with name and role stacked beneath, under a heading and badge. No cards or bios.

items.name: comparison-2
items.description: A two-column "Us vs. Them" layout with two side-by-side cards. The Acme card lists check rows of product advantages with a primary CTA, while the Others card lists cross rows of competitor pain points with strikethrough text.

items.name: gallery-2
items.description: A single large browser-framed product screenshot placeholder with a version badge and descriptive caption, plus a five-thumbnail strip beneath it for secondary screens.

items.name: empty-states-2
items.description: An empty inbox state centered in a solid-bordered card panel, featuring a muted illustration placeholder with a decorative box grid and inbox icon, a title and description, plus primary and secondary (link) action buttons with a support link below a separator.

items.name: billing-2
items.description: A billing invoices card displaying a table of past invoices with invoice number, date, amount, a status badge, and a per-row download link.

items.name: ai-chat-2
items.description: An AI chat that opens on a suggested-prompt empty state, then switches to a Message and Bubble thread on MessageScroller once a prompt is sent, with a multi-line composer.

items.name: onboarding-2
items.description: A three-card horizontal setup grid where each card presents a numbered onboarding step with an icon, title, short description, and a toggleable action button to mark it complete.

items.name: command-palette-2
items.description: A command palette panel with a search input, a Recent section showing timestamped file/page rows with hover-reveal arrows, and a Results section of icon-label-category-shortcut rows with one highlighted active selection and a footer keyboard-hint bar.

items.name: notifications-2
items.description: A compact notifications dropdown panel showing a bell trigger button with an unread badge, a small header with count, four notification rows each with an avatar-plus-icon treatment and unread dot, and a "View all notifications" footer link.

items.name: kanban-2
items.description: A single "In Progress" kanban column rendered as a vertical list of rich task cards, each showing a title, two-line description, priority badge with icon, label badges, a due date, and a stacked assignee avatar group.

items.name: calendar-2
items.description: A weekly agenda view showing Mon–Sun with time-slotted event rows, color-coded status borders and dots, and prev/today/next navigation.

items.name: file-upload-2
items.description: A compact inline file-upload form field with a bordered row and a "Choose file" label-trigger, plus an Attachment showing the selected file with its name, size, and a remove action.

items.name: charts-2
items.description: An analytics card with a gradient-filled area chart showing a monthly active users trend, topped by a three-KPI summary row (total, peak month, peak count) and a YoY growth badge.

items.name: hero-2
items.description: A split two-column hero with headline, subheadline, and two CTAs on the left, and a framed product-screenshot placeholder (stat cards, bar chart, table) on the right, stacked on mobile and side-by-side on desktop.

items.name: features-2
items.description: An alternating left/right features layout with three rows, each pairing a copy block (eyebrow, title, body paragraph, and a four-item bullet list) with a decorative image placeholder, separated by horizontal dividers.

items.name: pricing-2
items.description: A two-tier pricing layout with a side-by-side split panel: a filled Pro tier on the left and a plain Starter tier on the right, each showing a price, feature checklist, and CTA. No three-column grid, no top heading section.

items.name: testimonials-2
items.description: A single featured testimonial with a large centered quote, oversized avatar, name and role, and a company logo placeholder. No cards or grid, just a focused spotlight on one voice.

items.name: stats-2
items.description: A minimal four-up stat band with oversized numbers and short labels evenly spaced under a single short heading, with no badges, dividers, or secondary copy.

items.name: logo-cloud-2
items.description: A four-column grid of brand logos, each cell a muted card showing an icon mark and label, beneath a centered heading and subtext, structured for integration showcases.

items.name: cta-2
items.description: A compact bordered card on a bg-muted panel with a heading, single line of subtext, and one full-width primary button, centered and minimal.

items.name: faqs-2
items.description: A two-column FAQ layout where each question is a collapsible accordion item, separated by border rules, letting visitors expand answers on demand across two balanced columns.

items.name: integrations-2
items.description: A dense logo grid showing 18 integration services, each as a compact card with only a service icon and name. No descriptions or call-to-action buttons.

items.name: contact-2
items.description: A centered single-card contact form with split first/last name fields, a topic selector, message textarea, and a footer privacy note. No side details column.

items.name: header-2
items.description: A three-column header with logo pinned left, nav links absolutely centred, and a sign-in link plus primary CTA on the right, above a skeleton page-content placeholder.

items.name: footer-2
items.description: A compact single-tier footer with a brand mark and tagline on the left, an inline row of navigation links in the center, and a copyright notice on the right, all in one slim bar.

items.name: auth-2
items.description: A two-column split sign-in layout with a branded feature panel on the left and a minimal email + password form on the right. No social login buttons.

items.name: sidebar-2
items.description: A flat single-list sidebar nav (icon + label + optional badge count, one active item) beside a task table content area with priority indicators and status badges.

items.name: settings-2
items.description: A compact centered Profile card with an avatar upload section, vertical form fields (name, email, job title), a two-factor authentication Switch, and Discard/Save actions in the card footer.

items.name: dashboard-2
items.description: A stat-and-activity dashboard featuring four KPI cards with trend badges and a full-width recent-activity feed showing actor avatars, event descriptions, status badges, and timestamps. No chart.

items.name: table-2
items.description: A static invoices data table showing client avatars, project names, payment methods, due dates, status badges, and right-aligned amounts with a footer total row. No toolbar or pagination.

items.name: app-shell-2
items.description: A sidebar-free app shell with a sticky top bar (logo, search, avatar dropdown) above a tabbed content area featuring project cards, a task checklist, and an activity feed.

items.name: hero-3
items.description: Left-aligned hero with headline, subheadline, two CTAs, and a compact inline stat row showing three key business metrics with icons.

items.name: features-3
items.description: A dense two-column feature checklist with a short left-aligned heading, where each item shows a filled check square, a bold label, and one short description line. An "everything included" list with no cards or images.

items.name: pricing-3
items.description: A single-plan spotlight card centered on the page, featuring a large price display, a full feature checklist, a primary CTA, and a social-proof footnote, designed for one-tier products.

items.name: cta-3
items.description: Full-width inverted CTA banner on bg-primary with a bold heading, supporting line, and a high-contrast secondary button in a horizontal split layout.

items.name: faqs-3
items.description: Two-column FAQ layout with a heading, short support CTA card on the left, and a compact single-column accordion on the right.

items.name: dashboard-3
items.description: A compact KPI strip showing six metric tiles in a flush horizontal grid, each with label, large value, and directional delta, beneath a page title and period badge, with no cards, chart, or activity list.

items.name: auth-3
items.description: A two-panel sign-up card with a plan-overview sidebar and a create-account form featuring first/last name, email, password, a terms checkbox, and a sign-in link.

items.name: table-3
items.description: A static invoice line-items table with a caption showing billed-to details, per-item qty/unit/unit-price/amount columns, and a multi-row footer with subtotal, tax, and total due.

items.name: hero-4
items.description: Centered hero over a faint grid and radial glow with eyebrow badge, headline, and inline email capture row

items.name: hero-5
items.description: Centered hero with headline, two CTAs, and a trust strip of five inline-SVG wordmark company logos

items.name: logo-cloud-3
items.description: Infinite auto-scrolling logo marquee with edge fade mask and pause-on-hover for a trusted-by section

items.name: logo-cloud-4
items.description: Bordered grid of ten muted brand logos that colorize on hover, each with a name tooltip

items.name: cta-4
items.description: Centered CTA band with heading, inline email-capture form, and a no-spam privacy note in a muted card

items.name: cta-5
items.description: Split CTA with eyebrow, heading, dual buttons, and a framed faux app-screenshot card built from divs

items.name: faqs-4
items.description: FAQ accordion with a sticky "Still have questions?" contact support card alongside

items.name: faqs-5
items.description: FAQ with category tabs and a live search input that filters questions across General, Billing and Security

items.name: footer-3
items.description: Site footer pairing a newsletter signup with grouped nav columns and a social-icon bottom bar

items.name: footer-4
items.description: Mega footer with brand column, four sitemap columns, and a bottom bar with locale switcher and theme toggle

items.name: newsletter-3
items.description: Newsletter signup Card with idle, loading, success, and error states driven by a client state machine

items.name: newsletter-4
items.description: Multi-step newsletter Card with topic toggles and a double opt-in check-your-inbox confirmation

items.name: announcement-3
items.description: Dismissible single-line top announcement bar that persists dismissal in localStorage, over a page placeholder

items.name: announcement-4
items.description: Sticky promo bar with a live ticking sale countdown, fire icon, and shop CTA over a faint page mock

items.name: auth-4
items.description: Split-screen sign-in with email/password fields, remember-me switch, social buttons, and a branded value-prop panel

items.name: auth-5
items.description: Tabbed auth card that swaps sign-in and sign-up fields, with social login buttons and a divider

items.name: empty-states-3

items.name: empty-states-4
items.description: An error empty state for a failed data load, with a destructive accent and retry and contact-support actions.

items.name: integrations-3

items.name: integrations-4
items.description: Integration cards grid with per-card Connect/Connected toggle, Switch, badge and live connected count

items.name: features-4
items.description: Features section with category tabs that swap a 3-column grid of icon, title, and description cards

items.name: pricing-4
items.description: Three-tier pricing section with a monthly/annual segmented toggle and a highlighted most-popular plan

items.name: testimonials-3
items.description: A masonry wall of seven testimonial quote cards in varied heights with avatars, names, and roles

items.name: stats-4
items.description: Four-up metric band whose big numbers count up from zero with delta badges when scrolled into view

items.name: contact-3
items.description: Contact section with a message form beside a map placeholder and office location cards

items.name: header-3
items.description: Responsive sticky site header with logo, desktop nav, sign-in, a primary CTA, and a useState-toggled mobile menu sheet. Composable into page templates.

items.name: bento-4
items.description: Bento grid with a 2x2 hero tile and mixed-size supporting tiles, each with icon, text, and faint div visuals

items.name: how-it-works-3
items.description: Interactive horizontal stepper with a progress fill and clickable steps that stacks on mobile

items.name: blog-3
items.description: Blog index with a featured post, category filter pills, and a filterable 3-column grid of post cards

items.name: team-3
items.description: Responsive grid of eight team member cards that reveal a bio and social links on hover

items.name: comparison-3
items.description: Feature comparison table across 3 plans with grouped sections, check/value cells, sticky header and a highlighted column

items.name: gallery-3
items.description: Masonry image gallery with CSS columns and varied-ratio placeholder tiles that reveal a caption overlay on hover

items.description: App shell with a collapsible icon-rail sidebar, search top bar, avatar, and dashboard placeholder cards

items.name: sidebar-3
items.description: Collapsible icon-rail sidebar with grouped nav, badges, user footer, and tooltips when collapsed

items.name: settings-3
items.description: Tabbed settings page with Account profile fields and switch, Billing plan and payment card, and a Team members table

items.name: notifications-3
items.description: Notification center card with All/Unread/Mentions tabs, read state toggling, and a mark-all-read action

items.name: billing-3
items.description: Billing page with plan summary, usage bar, payment method card, and invoice history table

items.name: ai-chat-3
items.description: Live AI chat built on Message, Bubble, MessageScroller, and a shimmering Marker typing indicator, with suggestion chips and a textarea composer.

items.name: onboarding-3
items.description: Multi-step setup wizard card with progress bar, step indicator, per-step fields, toggles, invites and summary

items.name: command-palette-3
items.description: Interactive Cmd+K command palette with fuzzy search, grouped results, arrow-key navigation, and Kbd hints

items.name: calendar-3
items.description: Interactive month/week calendar with prev/next navigation, view toggle, event chips, and an inline day panel

items.name: file-upload-3
items.description: A drag-and-drop file uploader with an Attachment list that reflects uploading, done, and error states, with validation, toasts, and remove actions.

items.name: charts-3
items.description: Analytics area chart card with legend, hover tooltip, and a 7d/30d/90d range select that swaps the dataset

items.name: error-1
items.description: A centered 404 page with a heading, message, and home and back actions.

items.name: cookie-consent-1
items.description: A dismissible bottom cookie-consent bar with accept and decline actions and a policy link.

items.name: page-header-1
items.description: An application page header with a title, description, and action buttons.

items.name: coming-soon-1
items.description: A centered coming-soon page with a waitlist email capture and social links.

items.name: error-2
items.description: A 404 page with a search box and a list of popular pages to recover from.

items.name: error-3
items.description: A 500 error page with retry and contact-support actions and a reference code.

items.name: cookie-consent-2
items.description: A dismissible bottom-left cookie-consent card with accept, reject, and preferences.

items.name: cookie-consent-3
items.description: A cookie preferences card with toggle switches for each cookie category.

items.name: page-header-2
items.description: An application page header with breadcrumbs, a status badge, and action buttons.

items.name: page-header-3
items.description: An application page header with a title, description, tabs, and a primary action.

items.name: coming-soon-2
items.description: A split coming-soon page with a waitlist form and a framed product preview.

items.name: coming-soon-3
items.description: A coming-soon page with a live countdown timer and an email signup.

items.name: stats-3
items.description: A stats section with metric cards showing values and up or down deltas.

items.name: bento-3
items.description: An asymmetric bento grid with one large feature tile and supporting tiles.

items.name: timeline-1
items.description: A vertical left-rail milestone timeline. Each entry has a bordered icon node connected by a line, a monospaced date, a status badge (Shipped, In Progress, Planned), a bold title, and a line of supporting copy. Good for company history, release milestones, or an 'our journey' section.

items.name: timeline-2
items.description: A centered, two-sided timeline that alternates entries left and right of a vertical spine on desktop and collapses to a single left rail on mobile. Each entry shows a year, a tag badge, a bold title, and supporting copy. Ideal for an 'our story' or company-history section.

items.name: timeline-3
items.description: An activity timeline grouped by day, with rows of grayscale avatar, actor, action, and relative timestamp connected by a vertical rail, plus a small status icon on each avatar. A standalone feed for dashboards, profiles, or audit history.

items.name: changelog-1
items.description: A version-grouped changelog with a date and version rail on the left and Added, Improved, and Fixed change groups on the right, each with a type badge and a bulleted list. The classic release-notes layout for a marketing or docs page.

items.name: changelog-2
items.description: A tabbed changelog that filters release entries by type (All, Added, Improved, Fixed). Each entry shows a version, date, type badge, title, and description. An interactive release-notes view for docs or product pages.

items.name: changelog-3
items.description: A compact in-app 'What's New' card with a version pill, release date, and a few highlighted changes, each with a type icon and badge, plus a link to the full changelog. A product-update widget for dashboards or popovers.

items.name: roadmap-1
items.description: A three-column product roadmap board grouped by status (Planned, In Progress, Shipped). Cards carry a category badge, title, and description, plus per-status meta: a vote count when planned, a progress bar with contributor avatars when in progress, and a shipped date with avatars when done.

items.name: roadmap-2
items.description: A Now, Next, and Later roadmap with colored phase markers and a target month per phase. In-development items show a progress bar with contributor avatars while upcoming items show a vote count. A directional product roadmap.

items.name: roadmap-3
items.description: An interactive public roadmap card where visitors upvote feature requests. Each row has a vote button with a live count, a title, status and category badges, a description, and a progress bar with contributor avatars for in-development items. Good for feedback and feature-request pages.

items.name: article-1
items.description: A centered long-form article layout with a category badge, headline, deck, author byline with avatar and read time, a cover image, prose body with headings, a blockquote and list, and a footer with tags and share buttons. A blog post or editorial reading page.

items.name: article-2
items.description: A long-form article with a sticky table-of-contents sidebar that highlights the active section as you scroll (scroll-spy). Collapses to a single column on mobile. Ideal for documentation and in-depth guides.

items.name: article-3
items.description: A documentation article layout with a breadcrumb, title, last-updated meta, prose body with a code block, and previous/next pagination cards in the footer. A docs or knowledge-base reading page.

items.name: profile-1
items.description: A public profile page with a cover image, overlapping avatar, name and handle, bio, follower stats, a Follow toggle and Message action, and tabs for posts and about. For user, author, or member profiles.

items.name: profile-2
items.description: A compact, centered profile card with avatar, name, role, location, a three-column stat strip, and Follow and Message actions. A self-contained profile widget for sidebars, directories, or hover cards.

items.name: profile-3
items.description: An organization profile card with a logo mark, verified company name, description, a stat strip, a member avatar stack, and website and contact links. For company or team profile pages.

items.name: steps-1
items.description: A horizontal progress stepper with numbered nodes, connectors, and labels, showing completed (check), current, and upcoming states. For checkout, onboarding, or any multi-step flow header.

items.name: steps-2
items.description: A vertical stepper with numbered or checked nodes on a connecting rail, each step showing a title and description across completed, current, and upcoming states. For setup guides and onboarding checklists.

items.name: activity-1
items.description: A standalone Recent Activity card with avatar rows, each showing the actor, action, target, and relative time. A workspace activity feed for dashboards and profiles.

items.name: activity-2
items.description: An activity feed grouped by day with Today and Yesterday headers, each listing avatar rows with the actor, action, target, and time. For audit trails and team activity pages.

items.name: activity-3
items.description: An audit log feed with action-type icon tiles, a two-line event title and detail, a type tag, and a timestamp. For system, security, and audit activity without avatars.

items.name: search-1
items.description: A faceted search panel in a bordered card: a search field header, a left sidebar of type filters with counts that interactively narrow the results, and a result list with path, title, type badge, and snippet. For docs, knowledge base, or app search.

items.name: search-2
items.description: A clean search results page with a search field, a result count, and bordered result cards showing title, type badge, snippet, and last-updated date. For site, docs, or app search.

items.name: search-3
items.description: A command-style search panel with a query field and results grouped into Pages, People, and Files, each row with an icon or avatar and meta, plus keyboard hints in the footer. An inline search-as-you-type panel.

items.name: careers-1
items.description: An open-positions list grouping roles by department, each row showing the title, location, and employment type with an Apply call to action. A clean jobs board for a careers page.

items.name: careers-2
items.description: A single job posting detail page with the role title, meta chips for department, location, and type, an About section, responsibilities and requirements lists, and apply calls to action. A full role description layout.

items.name: about-1
items.description: A centered about-us intro with an eyebrow badge, a bold mission statement, a supporting paragraph, and a four-metric stats strip for founded year, customers, countries, and team size.

items.name: about-2
items.description: A two-column story section pairing a grayscale team photo with a company narrative and a three-metric stats row. A founder-story layout for an about page.

items.name: status-1
items.description: A system status overview with an all-systems-operational banner and a list of services, each showing its 90-day uptime and a colored status indicator. A status-page summary.

items.name: status-2
items.description: An incident history feed grouping past incidents by date, each with an impact badge and a timeline of color-coded status updates from investigating to resolved.

items.name: status-3
items.description: A 90-day uptime monitor showing per-service daily status bars colored by health, with uptime percentages and a status legend. The classic status-page history view.

items.name: chat-1
items.description: A one-to-one chat conversation built on the Message, Bubble, Marker, and MessageScroller components, with a contact header, sender-aligned bubbles, a dated separator, auto-follow scrolling, and a working composer. A direct-message thread.

items.name: chat-2
items.description: A two-pane messenger with a selectable conversation list and an active thread built on Message, Bubble, and MessageScroller, each conversation keeping its own messages, plus a working composer. A full inbox-style chat layout.

items.name: chat-3
items.description: A live support chat widget built on Message, Bubble, Marker, and MessageScroller, with an agent header, a system marker, quick-reply chips, and a working composer. A compact help-desk panel for customer support.

items.name: saas-landing
items.description: A complete SaaS marketing homepage assembled from free blocks: hero, social proof, features, stats, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, and a closing CTA.

items.name: startup
items.description: A lean, conversion-focused landing page for early-stage startups and product waitlists: a centered hero with inline email capture, key stats, an icon feature grid, a how-it-works timeline, a featured testimonial, and a waitlist signup band.

items.name: dashboard
items.description: A logged-in app starter: a collapsible sidebar and a command-palette top bar wrapping a dashboard of stat cards, an interactive area chart, and a sortable, paginated data table.

registries.name: aevr
registries.description: A small collection of focused, production‑ready components and primitives for React/Next.js projects—built on shadcn/ui and complementary libraries.

components.notes: Domain is parked/for-sale: homepage, /sitemap.xml, /registry all return an 'aevr.space' Above.com forsale parking page (assets.abovedomains.com/forsale.min.js). The /r/*.json item endpoint returns a plain Apache '404 Not Found' for every probe (button, badge, registry.json, index.json). No index, no sitemap, no items validate. Registry appears defunct.

registries.name: aicanvas
registries.description: 54 animated React components with AI reproduction prompts for Claude Code, Lovable, and v0. Free and open source.

items.name: ai-job-cards
items.title: AI Job Cards
items.description: Three AI job card stacks with swipe-to-cycle. Brand logos, bookmark toggle, springs.

items.name: andromeda-button
items.title: Andromeda Button
items.description: A sci-fi / blueprint-aesthetic button with five variants (default, outline, ghost, destructive, link), three sizes (small, medium, large), optional leading icon, and full hover / focus / active / disabled state coverage. Transparent hairline surfaces sit on a near-black canvas, with an electric-blue accent that brightens and glows on interaction.

items.name: meet-the-crew
items.title: Meet the Crew
items.description: A swipeable portrait card stack perfect for introducing a team, showcasing crew members, or picking an avatar. Four stacked cards fan out with soft rotations — drag to browse, tap to choose. Drop in your own photos and names for an About Us section, a character selector, or an onboarding profile picker.

items.name: blind-pull-toggle
items.title: Blind Pull Toggle
items.description: A dark/light mode toggle styled as a window-blind pull cord — click to yank the cord and watch the icon swap through a venetian-blind slat animation.

items.name: bubble-field
items.title: Bubble Field
items.description: A grid of outline circles that burst on hover — each expanding and fading like a soap bubble popping, then reforming, with a soft pastel blue palette.

items.name: charging-widget
items.title: Charging Widget
items.description: Circular battery indicator with animated liquid waves that rise as the percentage counts up, looping continuously.

items.name: crypto-swap
items.title: Crypto Swap
items.description: A crypto token-swap widget with live exchange rates, price impact, and an animated swap button.

items.name: cube-carousel
items.title: Cube Carousel
items.description: An interactive 3D photo cube with six placeholder images on its faces. Drag with your cursor to spin it freely on both axes; release and it coasts naturally to a stop. No buttons, no snap, no controls, just the cube and your hand.

items.name: curious-ai
items.title: Curious AI
items.description: A morphing 3D AI orb in Three.js with cyan and magenta rim lights, iridescent pink speckles on a wrinkled surface, and glowing pink robot-eye pills that follow your cursor and blink between idle looks.

items.name: danger-stripes
items.title: Danger Stripes
items.description: Three crossing caution-tape stripes on orange. Hover to shake, click to intensify.

items.name: delete-button
items.title: Delete Button
items.description: A red button that starts a five-second delete countdown, with a one-tap undo.

items.name: distortion-grid
items.title: Distortion Grid
items.description: A canvas grid of thin lines that slowly undulate with large sweeping waves. Hovering repels the grid fabric outward from the cursor, amplifying the distortion across the entire canvas.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A canvas-based dot grid background where hovering illuminates nearby dots with a smooth radial glow and organic fade.

items.name: emoji-burst
items.title: Emoji Burst
items.description: A button that explodes emojis outward in all directions. Five emoji sets cycle on each click.

items.name: expanding-tabs
items.title: Expanding Tabs
items.description: A monochrome tab bar of icon circles. Click one and it expands into a labeled pill.

items.name: flip-calendar
items.title: Flip Calendar
items.description: A desk-calendar widget showing dates 1–31 with a satisfying flip-clock page-turn animation.

items.name: traveldeck
items.title: Travel Deck
items.description: A swipeable deck of destination cards. Drag the front card down to fling it off-screen and reveal the next. Each card reveals an animated hotels counter as it comes forward.

items.name: glass-ai-compose
items.title: Glass AI Composer
items.description: Glassmorphism AI chat input with image upload, web search toggle, and model switcher.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Glassmorphism content cards with 3D tilt-on-hover, spring physics, and a cursor-following glare highlight.

items.name: glass-dock
items.title: Glass Dock
items.description: Glassmorphism macOS-style dock with cursor-proximity magnification. Icons scale with spring physics as the mouse approaches.

items.name: glass-modal
items.title: Glass Modal
items.description: Centered dialog with deep glass blur, scale-spring entrance, and staggered content reveal.

items.name: glass-music-player
items.title: Glass Music Player
items.description: Mini music player with glass surface, spinning vinyl art, animated progress bar, and ambient glow.

items.name: glass-navbar
items.title: Glass Navbar
items.description: Frosted glass navigation bar with animated active tab indicator, ambient color blobs, and spring-physics entrance.

items.name: glass-notification
items.title: Glass Notifications
items.description: Swipe-to-dismiss notification stack with glass cards and spring-animated layout transitions.

items.name: glass-progress
items.title: Glass Progress
items.description: Glassmorphism progress bar panel with glowing gradient fills, spring-animated counters, staggered reveal, and replay button.

items.name: glass-search-bar
items.title: Glass Search Bar
items.description: Glassmorphism search bar with animated suggestion dropdown, active state glow, and reduced-motion support.

items.name: glass-sidebar
items.title: Glass Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible glassmorphism sidebar with icon-only and full label states, spring-animated expand and collapse.

items.name: glass-slider
items.title: Glass Slider
items.description: Range sliders with glass tracks, glowing colored fills, and spring-animated thumbs that scale on drag.

items.name: glass-stepper
items.title: Glass Stepper
items.description: Glassmorphism numeric stepper with spring number flip, notification-style tinted buttons, and configurable min/max/step.

items.name: glass-tab-bar
items.title: Glass Tab Bar
items.description: Frosted glass pill tab bar with a sliding active indicator. Edge tabs snap flush to the container wall.

items.name: glass-tags
items.title: Glass Tags
items.description: Selectable pill-shaped tags with glass surfaces, unique color accents, and spring-animated check marks.

items.name: glass-toast
items.title: Glass Toast
items.description: Frosted glassmorphism toast notification stack with 4 variants, auto-dismiss progress bar, and spring-animated stacking.

items.name: glass-toggle
items.title: Glass Toggle
items.description: On/off toggles with glass housing and liquid-feel spring animation. Track color transitions smoothly.

items.name: glass-user-menu
items.title: Glass User Menu
items.description: Frosted glass user avatar trigger with animated dropdown, grouped menu items, and Log Out.

items.name: glitch-button
items.title: Glitch Button
items.description: A terminal-inspired button with a text scramble glitch effect on hover.

items.name: good-vibes
items.title: Good Vibes
items.description: Interactive typography where letters scale 2x and become bold on hover.

items.name: grid-lines
items.title: Grid Lines
items.description: A dot grid connected by thin lines. On hover, a radial wave pulses outward from the cursor, illuminating lines and dots as it spreads.

items.name: halo-type
items.title: Halo Type
items.description: Rotating 3D ring text animation — the front arc reads upright, the back arc upside-down.

items.name: interactive-card-stack
items.title: Interactive Card Stack
items.description: A scattered stack of photo cards. Drag, click, or arrow keys to focus any card.

items.name: jar-of-emotions
items.title: Emoji Reaction Jar
items.description: Glass jar widget. Click a reaction to spring the lid and watch the emoji bounce down.

items.name: label-cards
items.title: Label Cards
items.description: Colour-blocked label cards scattered at random angles. Tap one to spring it to centre.

items.name: magnetic-dots
items.title: Magnetic Dots
items.description: A dense grid of dots that get magnetically pulled toward the cursor, snapping back with a satisfying elastic bounce when you leave.

items.name: mark-toggle
items.title: Mark Toggle
items.description: An iOS-style pill toggle in warm earth and sand tones — the thumb carries a small icon that morphs from X to checkmark as it slides across.

items.name: mood-tracker
items.title: Mood Tracker
items.description: A feelings check-in card with six expressive faces. Drag the segmented slider and the face, label, and liquid color wash shift with your mood.

items.name: neon-clock
items.title: Seven-Segment Clock
items.description: A retro 7-segment LCD clock with pixel-grid overlay. Shows live HH:MM:SS with blinking colon, AM/PM indicator, day of week row, and full date.

items.name: new-project-modal
items.title: New Project Modal
items.description: A pill button that morphs into a soft-UI project creation form — title, description, 7-swatch color label picker, Private toggle, and a checkmark-confirm Create button.

items.name: noise-bg
items.title: Grain Background
items.description: A canvas-based grain background of randomly scattered dots that illuminate with a soft Gaussian glow and organic connection lines on hover.

items.name: noise-field
items.title: Noise Field
items.description: A grid of flowing arrows driven by layered sine-wave noise — like wind mapped on a weather chart. Hover to create a swirling vortex at the cursor.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: Kinetic text animation arranged in a circle. Hover slows the spin; letters push outward.

items.name: particle-constellation
items.title: Spider Web
items.description: An organic silk web that breathes with a slow idle bow. Hover to physically push the nodes — each intersection bounces back with tension, fading the strings near your cursor.

items.name: particle-sphere
items.title: Particle Sphere
items.description: 9,000 particles arranged on a sphere with warm gold and cool silver tones, slowly spinning in Three.js.

items.name: peel-corner-reveal
items.title: Peel to Scan
items.description: A portrait card whose corner peels on tap, revealing a scannable Wi-Fi QR code.

items.name: pill-toggle
items.title: Pill Toggle
items.description: A minimal iOS-style slider toggle — thumb glides between off (grey) and on (green) with a snappy spring. Fully responsive.

items.name: playful
items.title: Playful
items.description: Kinetic typography where letters jump, drop, and rotate on cursor proximity.

items.name: polaroid-stack
items.title: Polaroid Stack
items.description: Five polaroid photo cards stacked in a casual pile — click to fan them out in a spring-animated arc, hover to lift, click a card to spotlight it.

items.name: product-card-deck
items.title: Product Card Deck
items.description: A draggable card deck you flick through one card at a time. The top card leans toward your drag, then spins away with momentum to reveal the next, and the deck loops endlessly. Every card pairs a picture with a title and a pill action button with hover and press states.

items.name: radial-cards
items.title: Radial Cards
items.description: Seven health-metric cards bloom into a slowly rotating flower — tap any petal to pull it forward and read your stats up close.

items.name: radial-toolbar
items.title: Radial Toolbar
items.description: A radial context menu that fans out formatting tools around a centre button, with active toggle states and an animated label pill.

items.name: responsive-letters
items.title: Responsive Letters
items.description: Interactive text where each letter responds to cursor proximity, animating variable font properties (weight, stretch, italic, letter-spacing, skew) to create a deformation-under-pressure effect.

items.name: ripple-type
items.title: Ripple Type
items.description: SVG text animation warped by a turbulence filter. Toggle the fan — letters ripple.

items.name: runway-loader
items.title: Runway Loader
items.description: An airplane taxis down a runway progress bar, nose tilting up and taking off at 100%.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Two words scramble continuously in a pixel cipher. Hover the container to decrypt them one by one — mouse out and they snap back to noise.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A signature pad widget — pill button morphs into a canvas to draw with mouse or touch.

items.name: slice-type
items.title: Slice Type
items.description: A typographic magic trick. At rest you read one ambiguous word; hover and it splits into two — LIGHT lifting up, NIGHT sinking down, the shared letters resolving into separate glyphs.

items.name: slide-deck
items.title: Slide Deck
items.description: Swipeable card deck with four editorial slides. Navigate forward and back by drag or tap.

items.name: sphere-lines
items.title: Wireframe Globe
items.description: A wire-frame globe that breathes on its own — a narrow wave band drifts quietly across the surface. Hover to ripple the lines right where your cursor lands.

items.name: stack-tower
items.title: Stack Tower
items.description: A column of 12 stacked words that reads as a rotating 3D cylinder — 2D transforms skew, scale and shift each row so the rotation travels down the stack. Hover lights one row in warm orange without breaking the rhythm.

items.name: sticker-wall
items.title: Sticker Wall
items.description: A draggable sticker card wall. Drop notes, toss emoji, pile them up with real 2D physics.

items.name: taga-toggle
items.title: Taga Toggle
items.description: A playful pill toggle with an expressive face on the thumb — dead (×× eyes, flat mouth) when off, happy (arc eyes, big smile) when on. Track warms from grey to yellow.

items.name: task-cards
items.title: Task Cards
items.description: A swipeable project task card stack where each card has a unique accent colour, status badge, and due date. Drag left or right to cycle through tasks — springs back the dismissed card to the bottom of the deck.

items.name: text-blur-reveal
items.title: Text Blur Reveal
items.description: Words animate into view one by one with a satisfying blur-to-sharp entrance, auto-replaying in a loop.

items.name: tilted-coverflow
items.title: Tilted Coverflow
items.description: 3D coverflow card carousel of seven tilted photos. Drag or arrows to focus any card.

items.name: upload-progress
items.title: Upload Progress
items.description: A collapsible file upload widget with a shimmer progress bar — indigo while uploading, amber on pause. Expand to see per-file rows with live progress, time remaining, and pause, resume, refresh, and stop controls.

items.name: voice-chat-pill
items.title: Live Session Pill
items.description: A compact live-session presence pill with an animated speaking indicator and overlapping avatars — clicks open a soft-UI modal showing all participants with a Join Now button.

items.name: wave-lines
items.title: Wave Lines
items.description: Dense vertical lines that ripple across the canvas — two layered sine waves create organic bunching and breathing. Hover to send the lines into extreme waves across the whole canvas.

items.name: wild-morph

items.description: Italic SVG word that warps under the cursor — a spring-physics text animation.

components.notes: aliimam.in is Ali Imam's personal portfolio (Next.js). Only real routes are /, /about, /works. The /r/*.json item endpoint and /components, /registry.json, /sitemap.xml all return the generic Next.js 404 HTML shell (route not implemented) for every probe (button, hero, patterncraft, geometric-lines, shader-lines). 'PatternCraft'/background-pattern strings appear ONLY in SEO meta keywords. og:url leaks http://localhost:4000. No registry items served; author contributes components (e.g. 'Shader Lines') to 21st.dev / shadcn directory instead.

registries.name: amplo
registries.description: OKLCH-native, Display-P3-aware composable fill picker with WCAG/APCA contrast metrics, gamut detection, and full keyboard accessibility.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Amplo Color Picker
items.description: OKLCH-native, Display-P3-aware color picker built on Base UI primitives — Hue/Lightness/Alpha on Slider, FormatSwitcher on Select, ChannelInput on NumberField, Swatches on RadioGroup. Pulls the shared OKLCH engine and pointer-driven parts (Area, Chroma, GamutBadge, ContrastReadout, Preview, EyeDropper, CssInput) as a registry dependency.

items.name: gradient-picker
items.title: Amplo Gradient Picker
items.description: Linear / radial / conic gradient editing on Base UI primitives — TypeSwitcher/InterpSwitcher/RadialSizeSelect on Select, ReverseStops and the StopList editor as semantic buttons with a self-contained popover. Pulls the color picker plus the shared gradient engine (Bar, Area, Overlay, pads, Presets, CssInput) as registry dependencies.

items.name: fill-picker
items.title: Amplo Fill Picker

registries.description: Production-ready dot-matrix loading components for React, featuring square, circular, and triangle animations with polished motion.

items.name: dotm-square-1
items.title: Neon Drift
items.description: Same ripple family as the icon, with a wave that sweeps from the top-right toward the bottom-left.

items.name: dotm-square-2
items.title: Pulse Ladder
items.description: Clockwise snake route: starts bottom-left up column 1, jumps to column 3 down, then column 2 up, and continues the same cycle to the right.

items.name: dotm-square-3
items.title: Core Spiral
items.description: A 4-dot tail spirals clockwise from the outer border toward the center of the 5x5 grid.

items.name: dotm-square-4
items.title: Twin Orbit
items.description: Outer ring snake moves clockwise, middle ring snake moves anticlockwise, and the center dot stays inactive.

items.name: dotm-square-5
items.title: Prism Sweep
items.description: Snake-style trail that traverses the 5x5 grid on alternating diagonals.

items.name: dotm-square-6
items.title: Flux Columns
items.description: Five simultaneous snakes: columns 1/3/5 move up while columns 2/4 move down.

items.name: dotm-square-7
items.title: Block Drop
items.description: Tetromino-like frames drop and stack in a 5x5 matrix, then flash a row-clear beat.

items.name: dotm-square-8
items.title: Strobe Stack
items.description: Each column stacks upward on a stagger (Tetris-style), the full grid blinks twice, then columns drain downward with the same stagger.

items.name: dotm-square-9
items.title: Glyph Pulse
items.description: Two synced 2×3 cells (Unicode dot order) step through clear motifs: rails, full grid, three rows, checker, horseshoes, and alternating columns.

items.name: dotm-square-10
items.title: CRT Glide
items.description: A CRT-style horizontal scanline moves down the matrix; swept rows leave a soft phosphor trail with a slight column-wise warp.

items.name: dotm-square-11
items.title: Echo Ring
items.description: Concentric diamond ripple with a soft secondary echo pulse per ring.

items.name: dotm-square-12
items.title: Origin Wave
items.description: Ripple starts at cell (2,2) and expands outward in concentric rings.

items.name: dotm-square-13
items.title: Core Rotor
items.description: Single fan blade rotating around a center hub for a clean, readable loop.

items.name: dotm-square-14
items.title: Prism Bloom
items.description: A symmetric kaleidoscope bloom cycling through clean radial motifs.

items.name: dotm-square-15
items.title: Helix Glow
items.description: Two mirrored strands with periodic bridges pulse like a compact DNA helix.

items.name: dotm-square-16
items.title: Helix Core
items.description: A narrower helix variant that stays in the center band while preserving strand/rung rhythm.

items.name: dotm-square-17
items.title: Half Helix
items.description: Single-strand helix variant that shows one side of the DNA wave.

items.name: dotm-square-18
items.title: Sound Bars
items.description: Equalizer-style vertical bars that pulse like live music levels.

items.name: dotm-square-19
items.title: Infinity Run
items.description: Dual counter-rotating heads trace a figure-eight with a soft crossover pulse at center.

items.name: dotm-square-20
items.title: Mobius Run
items.description: A bright head and tail run around the outer ring; a dimmer second train stays half a lap behind, with inner corner flashes for the twist.

items.name: dotm-circular-1
items.title: Halo Drift
items.description: A circular-masked half-helix that travels diagonally from top-left to bottom-right with a bright strand and soft adjacent trail.

items.name: dotm-circular-2
items.title: Tri Orbit
items.description: Three luminous heads orbit the circular ring at equal offsets, creating a triad chase that never overlaps into the old snake rhythm.

items.name: dotm-circular-3
items.title: Plasma Veil
items.description: A plasma-like diagonal sweep and pulsing core weave through the circular mask for a distinctly different motion signature.

items.name: dotm-circular-4
items.title: Radar Arc
items.description: A rotating radar arm scans the circular grid with a bright beam front, soft wake, and faint perimeter ring echo.

items.name: dotm-circular-5
items.title: Nova Wheel
items.description: Four rotating pinwheel blades spin through the circular matrix with a glowing center and soft trailing halo.

items.name: dotm-circular-6
items.title: Phase Orb
items.description: An off-center orbiting energy point traces a phase-shifted loop, creating a drifting orbital glow inside the circular matrix.

items.name: dotm-circular-7
items.title: Gate Shift
items.description: A scanning gate flips between vertical and horizontal sweeps, producing a crisp alternating shutter rhythm in the circular grid.

items.name: dotm-circular-8
items.title: Heart Pulse
items.description: Pulse bursts from the center with a dual-beat cadence, sending soft concentric pressure waves across the circular matrix.

items.name: dotm-circular-9
items.title: Star Compass
items.description: A cardinal beacon pattern: N/E/S/W sectors pulse in sequence with a dim opposite echo, creating a clear directional rhythm in the circular mask.

items.name: dotm-circular-10
items.title: Binary Bloom
items.description: Binary-style opacity tiers pulse in modular steps so only a few cells peak at once while others stay low, producing a crisp coded bloom.

items.name: dotm-circular-11
items.title: Lunar Breathe
items.description: A rotating crescent moon silhouette: bright lunar body, soft rim, and faint directional halo moving around the circular mask.

items.name: dotm-circular-12
items.title: Arc Beacon
items.description: A stepped 8-direction beacon beam sweeps around the circle with a dim opposite echo and diagonal spoke accents.

items.name: dotm-circular-13
items.title: Twin Helix
items.description: A circular-masked twin-helix: mirrored side strands weave inward and outward with intermittent interior bridge pulses.

items.name: dotm-circular-14
items.title: Rung Shift
items.description: A shifting DNA ladder where a bright horizontal rung steps row-by-row while side anchors sway and leave soft ghost echoes.

items.name: dotm-circular-15
items.title: Glyph Cluster
items.description: Braille-inspired grouped dot motifs cycle through rails, bridges, and cross forms inside the circular mask with crisp tiered opacity.

items.name: dotm-circular-16
items.title: Rail Scan
items.description: A braille rail scanline sweeps row-by-row between left and right cells, with near-column accents and soft trail falloff.

items.name: dotm-circular-17
items.title: Checker Shift
items.description: Braille-biased checker phases alternate in stepped shifts, keeping rails pronounced while the center cross supports readability.

items.name: dotm-circular-18
items.title: Pulse Pair
items.description: Mirrored braille dot pairs pulse from top and bottom toward the center, with a connective center-column accent.

items.name: dotm-circular-19
items.title: Orbit Cell
items.description: A bright braille cell head orbits the inner ring with a dim tail while rail columns remain softly active.

items.name: dotm-circular-20
items.title: Glyph Cycle
items.description: Distinct braille-like glyphs cycle in sequence with previous-frame ghosting for a crisp readable symbol transition.

items.name: dotm-triangle-1
items.title: Core Spokes
items.description: A triangle-masked matrix where three spoke lines originate at the center and travel outward to each triangle edge.

items.name: dotm-triangle-2
items.title: Altitude Wave
items.description: A soft altitude wave travels between apex and base while the center column remains gently present for shape readability.

items.name: dotm-triangle-3
items.title: Corner Bounce
items.description: A single head bounces between triangle corners along the perimeter path with a short fading tail.

items.name: dotm-triangle-4
items.title: Vertex Chase
items.description: Three staggered heads chase around the triangle perimeter, leaving short fading tails while all dots stay fixed in place.

items.name: dotm-triangle-5
items.title: Row Sweep
items.description: A reflected scanline sweeps from apex to base and back, animating only opacity bands across triangle rows.

items.name: dotm-triangle-6
items.title: Braille Beat
items.description: Triangle-masked braille dots fill down the left rail, then the right, then blink full and empty.

items.name: dotm-triangle-7
items.title: Oblique Weave
items.description: Diagonal harmonics keyed on row + col: bright bands glide along oblique lines through the triangle with a subtle second harmonic for texture.

items.name: dotm-triangle-8
items.title: Wing Metronome
items.description: The lower triangle splits into left and right wings that trade emphasis on a pendulum beat; apex and center pulse brightest when both sides meet in the middle.

items.name: dotm-triangle-9
items.title: Corona Tier
items.description: Eight-connected distance rings from the heart cell: a bright corona sweeps outward through discrete tiers then back, so depth reads as concentric energy shells.

items.name: dotm-triangle-10
items.title: Column Rake
items.description: A stepped head and tail snake the mask in strict column order (bottom to top per column, columns left to right), unlike perimeter chases or diagonal waves.

items.name: dotm-triangle-11
items.title: Shelf Descent
items.description: Cosine bands keyed on Manhattan distance from the apex (not the center): energy reads as horizontal tiers dropping through the triangle.

items.name: dotm-triangle-12
items.title: Skew Drift
items.description: Traveling harmonics on `row - col` so bright ridges move along NE–SW obliques, orthogonal in feel to diagonal loaders that use `row + col`.

items.name: dotm-triangle-13
items.title: Serpent Zip
items.description: A stepped snake follows row-wise serpentine order (base left→right, then alternating row directions) with a long tail — zigzag motion, not a column path.

items.name: dotm-triangle-14
items.title: Pillar Sweep
items.description: A smooth vertical beam sweeps grid columns 0→6; only triangle-masked dots respond so the silhouette lights one vertical slice at a time.

items.name: dotm-triangle-15
items.title: Tripod Handoff
items.description: Brightness hands off smoothly among the three silhouette vertices (apex, left base, right base) with Manhattan falloff — a corner-to-corner orbit, not a mod-3 lattice.

items.name: dotm-triangle-16
items.title: Updraft
items.description: A V-shaped thermal ridge moves through row-and-column space: brightness peaks along an inverted V so the front climbs the two lower flanks toward the apex, not a flat horizontal row scan like Row Sweep.

items.name: dotm-triangle-17
items.title: Infinity Trace
items.description: A stepped head and tail follow a single 10-cell path: left base up to the apex, down the right rim, then through (4,4) → center → (4,2) for a crossing loop.

items.name: dotm-triangle-18
items.title: Hollow Shell
items.description: The heart cell stays locked dim while every other triangle dot breathes together in phase — a hollow, ring-like pulse.

items.name: dotm-triangle-19
items.title: Pivot Ray
items.description: A Gaussian wedge of brightness rotates around the heart cell using each dot’s polar angle — a clear pivoting searchlight, not a cosine-product moiré field.

items.name: dotm-triangle-20
items.title: Twin Perimeter
items.description: Two stepped heads chase the outer perimeter path half a lap apart, each with its own tail; the heart cell stays quietly dim off the loop.

items.name: dotm-hex-1
items.title: Hex Orbit
items.description: A 3-4-5-4-3 hexagonal dot field with two soft perimeter heads chasing around the shell while the center stays quietly lit.

items.name: dotm-hex-2
items.title: Prism Bloom
items.description: Three rotating spokes sweep through the hex field with a soft outer shell pulse and a breathing center point.

items.name: dotm-hex-3
items.title: Honey Gate
items.description: Two diagonal bands slide through the honeycomb from opposite sides, meeting in a bright center flash before opening again.

items.name: dotm-hex-4
items.title: Vertex Relay
items.description: A bright signal hands off around the hex vertices while inner echo dots answer each corner and the center keeps a quick pulse.

items.name: dotm-hex-5
items.title: Spiral Lattice
items.description: Counter-rotating spiral waves cross through the hex lattice, creating a fast core pulse and softer outer wake.

items.name: dotm-hex-6
items.title: Chevron March
items.description: Smooth chevron bands flow through the hex field in a wrapped loop, keeping an obvious arrow pattern without a reset snap.

items.name: dotm-hex-7
items.title: Hourglass Flip
items.description: Top and bottom bars squeeze into a bright center hourglass, then flip into side rails and a diamond.

items.name: dotm-hex-8
items.title: Glyph Flip
items.description: Crisp symbolic masks flip between stars, chevrons, and rails for a snappy pixel-glyph loader.

items.name: dotm-hex-9
items.title: Petal Shimmer
items.description: A four-petal highlight rotates through the hex with a soft shell sheen and steady center glow.

items.name: dotm-hex-10
items.title: Liquid Vortex
items.description: Refined swirl bands and a slower lens highlight create a smoother liquid shimmer through the hex lattice.

items.name: dotm-3x3-1
items.title: Square Spiral
items.description: A compact 3×3 grid with a four-dot tail spiraling clockwise from the outer border toward the center.

items.name: dotm-3x3-2
items.title: Drift TR
items.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the top-right corner toward the bottom-left.

items.name: dotm-3x3-3
items.title: Drift TL
items.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the top-left corner toward the bottom-right.

items.name: dotm-3x3-4
items.title: Drift BR
items.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the bottom-right corner toward the top-left.

items.name: dotm-3x3-5
items.title: Drift BL
items.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the bottom-left corner toward the top-right.

items.name: dotm-3x3-6
items.title: Core Echo
items.description: Manhattan rings ripple outward from the center cell, expanding through the 3×3 grid in even steps.

items.name: dotm-3x3-7
items.title: Column Flux
items.description: Vertical bands pulse in sequence from the left column through the right, lighting all three rows in each column together.

items.name: dotm-3x3-8
items.title: Row Sweep
items.description: Horizontal bands pulse in sequence from the top row down through the bottom of the 3×3 matrix.

items.name: dotm-3x3-9
items.title: Serpent
items.description: A narrow pulse travels the full serpentine path across all nine cells, row by row.

items.name: dotm-3x3-10
items.title: Frame Chase
items.description: A highlight runs clockwise around the outer frame while the center cell holds a steady pulse.

items.name: dotm-3x3-11
items.title: Glyph Pulse
items.description: Bold symbol motifs flash in sequence — corners, cross, full grid, center, ring, X, and side rails — like a tiny pixel display.

items.name: dotm-3x3-12
items.title: Drop Ripple
items.description: Concentric ripples expand from the center of the 3×3 grid, like a stone dropped in still water.

items.name: dotm-3x3-13
items.title: Right Surge
items.description: A vertical wave pulse sweeps from the right column toward the left, illuminating every row in each band together.

items.name: dotm-3x3-14
items.title: Comet Trail
items.description: A bright comet with a two-dot tail races clockwise around the outer frame while the center cell softly breathes.

items.name: dotm-3x3-15
items.title: Echo Rings
items.description: Soft square ripples echo outward from the center through Manhattan rings, with a gentle alternating shimmer.

items.name: dotm-3x3-16
items.title: Smiley Spin
items.description: A pixel smiley face rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

items.name: dotm-3x3-18
items.title: Check Spin
items.description: A pixel checkmark rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

items.name: dotm-3x3-19
items.title: Arrow Spin
items.description: A pixel right arrow rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

items.name: dotm-3x3-20
items.title: Corner Spin
items.description: An L-shaped pixel corner rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

items.name: dotm-3x3-21
items.title: Play Spin
items.description: A pixel play triangle rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

items.description: Chip-based multi-select with command-palette dropdown, search, select-all and async loader. Compound and single-prop APIs.

items.name: number-range

items.name: password-input

items.name: currency-input

items.name: phone-input

items.name: file-dropzone

items.name: rating

items.name: timeline

items.name: all
items.title: All UI components
items.description: Installs all UI components from this registry.

registries.name: jalco
registries.description: A curated collection of GitHub-integrated, documentation, and developer-facing components. Self-contained, zero-dependency, and production-ready.

items.name: code-block
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with bundled language icon, copy button, and optional scrollable or collapsible overflow. Server component powered by shiki.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.description: Code diff viewer with line numbers and add/remove coloring. Supports unified and split layouts.

items.name: code-block-command
items.description: Tabbed CLI command block with package manager switching (pnpm, yarn, npm, bun, shadcn), bundled SVG icons, copy button, and localStorage persistence.

items.name: code-line
items.description: Compact single-line code snippet with syntax highlighting and an inline copy button. Ideal for imports, CLI commands, env vars, and config values.

items.name: ai-copy-button
items.description: Split button with a primary copy action and a dropdown of AI destinations. Copy content, view as markdown, or open in v0, ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Keyboard shortcut key rendered as a styled keycap. Three visual profiles: flat, raised, and sculpted.

items.name: api-ref-table
items.description: Expandable prop reference table with color-coded types, optional descriptions, and full-type details. Designed for component documentation pages.

items.name: file-tree
items.description: Collapsible file and folder tree with file-type icons, highlights, and configurable expand state. Designed for project structure docs, README displays, and dev-tool file explorers.

items.name: stepper
items.description: Numbered step-by-step layout with vertical connector lines, auto-incrementing step numbers, and status indicators. Designed for installation guides, tutorials, onboarding flows, and multi-step documentation. Composable — nest any content inside each step.

items.name: color-palette
items.description: Color swatch display with name, hex/hsl/rgb values, and click-to-copy. Grid and horizontal scale strip layouts for design system documentation.

items.name: activity-graph
items.description: GitHub-style activity heatmap that visualizes daily counts as a color-intensity grid with month labels, day labels, and a Less/More legend. Includes a helper to fetch real GitHub contribution data by username.

items.name: ci-badge
items.description: GitHub Actions CI status badge showing passing, failing, pending, or cancelled state with colored status dot and optional duration. Two layouts: inline pill and expanded card. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: commit-graph
items.description: Git commit history as a vertical timeline with hashes, messages, author avatars, and branch/tag labels.

items.name: contributor-grid
items.description: GitHub contributor display with avatar grid and detailed list layouts. Async server component with ISR caching.

items.name: github-button-group
items.description: Segmented button group displaying multiple GitHub repo metrics with per-segment links. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: github-stars-button
items.description: Link button showing a GitHub repo's star count with the octocat icon. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: release-badge
items.description: Live GitHub release badge showing latest tag, publish date, and pre-release indicator. Three layouts: inline pill, horizontal row, and expanded card. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: repo-card
items.description: GitHub repository preview card with description, language dot, star and fork counts, license, and topic tags. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: discord-badge
items.description: Live Discord server badge showing server name and online count with the Discord icon. Two layouts: inline pill and expanded card. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR via the public widget API.

items.name: download-sparkline
items.description: Tiny inline SVG sparkline showing npm download trends over time. Three chart types, trend indicator, date range, and average baseline. Pure SVG, zero charting dependencies. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: license-badge
items.description: Software license badge with SPDX identifier, category color-coding, and OSI-approved indicator. Three layouts: inline pill, segmented row, and expanded card. Accepts a license string directly or fetches from the GitHub API.

items.name: npm-badge
items.description: Live npm package badge showing version, weekly downloads, license, and last publish date. Three layouts: inline pill, horizontal row, and expanded card. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: producthunt-button
items.description: Link button showing a Product Hunt post's upvote count with the PH cat icon. Two layouts: inline button and expanded card. Async server component — fetches data at build time with ISR.

items.name: cron-schedule
items.description: Visual cron expression display with field breakdown, human-readable summary, and optional next-run preview. Designed for dashboards, serverless function docs, and scheduling UIs.

items.name: env-table
items.description: Read-only environment variable table with masked values, click-to-reveal, per-row copy, and bulk copy as .env. Designed for settings pages, deploy previews, and documentation.

items.name: json-viewer
items.description: Collapsible, syntax-colored JSON tree with path copying, search, expand/collapse controls, and 65 editor color themes. Designed for dev dashboards, API documentation, and debugging tools.

items.name: log-viewer
items.description: Scrollable log output component for displaying streaming logs or CLI-style output in web apps. Three variants: terminal (full CLI-style with toolbar, line numbers, search), minimal (compact scrolling lines), and filterable (level filtering with counts). Supports colored log levels, timestamps, auto-scrolling, copy, and export.

items.name: request-viewer
items.description: Network request inspector showing headers, response body, and timing waterfall. Designed for dev dashboards, API documentation, and debugging tools.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.description: "Trusted by" logo display with static grid and infinite-scroll marquee layouts. Grayscale by default, color on hover.

items.name: testimonial
items.description: Customer testimonial display with standalone card, responsive grid, and infinite-scroll marquee layouts.

items.name: status-indicator
items.description: Operational status badge with colored dot and label for dashboards, status pages, and header bars.

items.name: tip-jar
items.description: Donation and tipping component with QR code, wallet address or handle display, and copy-to-clipboard. Supports crypto chains (Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, and more) and platforms (PayPal, Ko-fi, Patreon). Six layout variants for different contexts.

items.name: pretext
items.description: React hooks for DOM-free text measurement using @chenglou/pretext. Provides prepare/layout lifecycle, shrinkwrap search, and balanced-width computation.

items.name: balanced-text
items.description: Text wrapper that uses Pretext to balance line widths so all lines are roughly equal length. Deterministic and cross-browser consistent.

items.name: chat-bubble
items.description: Message bubble with Pretext shrinkwrap that finds the tightest width for the same line count, eliminating dead space CSS fit-content leaves behind.

items.name: masonry-grid
items.description: Text-aware masonry layout where card heights are predicted by Pretext without DOM measurement. Zero layout shift.

items.name: cell-header

items.name: cell-type-button

items.name: execution-status
items.title: ExecutionStatus
items.description: A badge component that displays the execution state of a notebook cell. Shows queued, running, or error states.

items.name: play-button
items.title: PlayButton
items.description: Cell execution control button that shows Play, Stop, or Loading states based on execution state. Used in notebook cell toolbars.

items.name: runtime-health-indicator
items.title: RuntimeHealthIndicator
items.description: A visual indicator for kernel connection status. Shows idle, busy, connecting, or disconnected states with color-coded dots. Can display kernel name and optionally function as a button.

items.name: cell-controls
items.title: CellControls
items.description: Cell action menu with source visibility toggle, move controls, and dropdown menu for delete and clear operations.

items.name: cell-container
items.title: CellContainer
items.description: A focus and selection wrapper for notebook cells with gutter ribbon system. Color-coded ribbons indicate cell type, with action area for play button and execution count.

items.name: cell-betweener
items.title: CellBetweener
items.description: Spacer component that maintains gutter ribbon continuity between cells. Creates an unbroken 'paper edge' effect down the left side of the notebook.

items.name: output-area
items.title: OutputArea
items.description: Wrapper component for rendering multiple Jupyter outputs with collapsible state and scroll behavior.

items.name: execution-count
items.title: ExecutionCount
items.description: Displays the classic Jupyter execution count indicator with bracket notation. Shows [ ]: for never executed, [*]: for executing, and [n]: for executed cells.

items.name: collaborator-avatars
items.title: CollaboratorAvatars
items.description: Display avatars of users collaborating on a notebook with overflow handling.

items.name: presence-bookmarks
items.title: PresenceBookmarks
items.description: Shows stacked user avatars indicating who is present on a cell. Displays a HoverCard with user details and a +N overflow indicator when users exceed the limit.

items.name: codemirror-editor
items.title: CodeMirror Editor
items.description: A CodeMirror 6 editor component for notebook cells with syntax highlighting, key bindings, and language support for Python, IPython (with magics and shell commands), Markdown, SQL, HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript, and JSON.

items.name: widget-store
items.title: Widget Store
items.description: Pure React state management for Jupyter widget models. Handles comm_open, comm_msg, and comm_close messages with fine-grained subscriptions via useSyncExternalStore. Includes comm protocol router and buffer utilities.

items.name: anywidget-view
items.title: AnyWidget View
items.description: React component for rendering anywidget ESM modules with the AFM (AnyWidget Frontend Module) interface. Handles dynamic ESM loading, CSS injection, and two-way state synchronization.

items.name: widget-view
items.title: Widget View
items.description: Universal widget router that renders Jupyter widgets. Routes anywidgets to ESM loader and standard ipywidgets to built-in shadcn-backed components.

items.name: widget-controls
items.title: Widget Controls
items.description: Built-in shadcn-backed widget components for standard ipywidgets including controls (IntSlider, FloatSlider, IntRangeSlider, FloatRangeSlider, IntProgress, Button, Checkbox, Text, Textarea, HTML, ColorPicker, Dropdown, RadioButtons, ToggleButton, ToggleButtons, SelectMultiple) and layout containers (VBox, HBox, Box, GridBox, Accordion, Tab).

items.name: ipycanvas
items.title: ipycanvas Widget
items.description: Canvas widget for ipycanvas. Renders an HTML canvas and processes drawing commands sent from Python via the ipycanvas binary protocol. Supports shapes, paths, text, transforms, batch operations, and mouse/keyboard events.

items.name: isolated-frame
items.title: Isolated Frame
items.description: Secure iframe component for rendering untrusted output content. Uses blob URLs with sandbox restrictions to isolate JavaScript execution. Includes message bridge for parent-child communication and widget comm protocol support.

items.name: cell-type-selector
items.title: CellTypeSelector
items.description: A dropdown selector for changing cell types in notebook interfaces. Supports filtering available types and displays the current type with color-coded styling.

items.name: error-boundary
items.title: Error Boundary
items.description: React error boundary with resetKeys support for automatic recovery. Includes OutputErrorFallback and WidgetErrorFallback components for graceful error display in outputs and widgets.

items.name: highlight-text
items.title: Highlight Text
items.description: DOM utility for highlighting search matches in text content with customizable styling.

items.name: isolated-renderer
items.title: Isolated Renderer
items.description: Complete isolated iframe renderer bundle for Jupyter outputs and widgets. Runs inside a sandboxed iframe with its own React app, receiving render commands via postMessage. Includes widget bridge client for two-way comm protocol support. This is a standalone entry point that can be built separately (includes vite.config.ts).

items.name: all
items.title: All nteract Components
items.description: Install all Jupyter frontend components: outputs, cell primitives, widgets, editor, icons, and UI components.

items.name: global-find-bar
items.title: Global Find Bar
items.description: Floating search bar for notebook-wide find functionality. Supports keyboard navigation (Enter/Shift+Enter for next/prev, Escape to close). Works with search-highlight CodeMirror extension for in-cell highlighting.

items.name: runtime-icons
items.title: Runtime Icons
items.description: SVG icons for runtime environments and package managers. Includes DenoIcon, PythonIcon, UvIcon, CondaIcon, and PixiIcon for notebook and onboarding UIs.

items.name: selection-card
items.title: Selection Card
items.description: A stylized selection card component for wizard and onboarding UIs. Includes SelectionCard with icon, title, description, and color-coded selection state, plus PageDots for step navigation and BRAND_COLORS preset for common tools.

registries.name: openpolicy
registries.description: Open-source components for building terms, privacy policies and cookie banners.

components.notes: openpolicy.sh 308-redirects to policystack.dev (project renamed to PolicyStack). PolicyStack is now distributed as npm packages (@policystack/core, @policystack/react) with components PolicyStack/ConsentGate/CookieBanner and framework adapters (React/Vue/Solid/Svelte/Angular) - NOT a shadcn /r/ registry. No index (/r/registry.json, /r/index.json, /registry.json, /api/registry all 404/redirect) and 18 probed item names (cookie-banner, consent-banner, privacy-policy, terms, etc.) returned 404 on both openpolicy.sh and policystack.dev. Homepage mentions a 'shadcn-style consent banner' but no installable /r/ items exist.

items.title: Pricing select cards
items.description: Selectable pricing cards with localized prices from Paddle, available in stacked and grid layouts. Uses RadioGroup for single-plan selection — designed for express checkout flows.

items.description: Mobile-first checkout experience with pricing cards and sheet-style checkout drawer. Automatically resizes based on the height of the checkout.

items.title: Billing interval toggle
items.description: Segmented control for switching between billing intervals. Renders labels automatically from interval keys (month -> Monthly, year -> Annually). Designed for pricing pages and plan selectors.

items.title: Pricing cards
items.description: Responsive pricing tier cards with plan name, localized price, feature list, and per-card CTA. Supports current-plan highlighting and selection state for pricing pages and plan change flows.

items.title: Pricing display
items.description: Pricing section with localized prices, billing interval toggle, and built-in overlay checkout. Supports current-plan highlighting and plan change selection flows via currentPriceIds and selectedPriceId props.

items.name: checkout-summary
items.title: Checkout summary
items.description: Order summary for inline checkout: line items, totals, recurring/trial info, and refund policy link. Compliance-ready display for Paddle inline checkout.

items.name: inline-checkout
items.title: Inline checkout
items.description: Inline checkout block with order summary, Paddle payment frame, and real-time event updates. Supports reactive item changes, plan switching, and quantity updates.

items.name: subscription-status-card
items.title: Subscription status card
items.description: Subscription overview card showing plan details, status, billing cycle, line item breakdown, discount, scheduled changes, and optional action buttons. Supports single and multi-item subscriptions, past-due alerts, collection mode indicators, and configurable badge position.

items.name: subscription-alert
items.title: Subscription alert
items.description: Contextual alerts for subscription events: payment failures, scheduled cancellations, pauses, trials. Derives the correct alert from subscription state automatically.

items.name: subscription-payment-card
items.title: Subscription payment card
items.description: Payment method and next billing summary card. Auto-resolves payment method display labels from Paddle type/brand/last4 fields. Shows next payment amount, date, and portal link to update payment details.

items.name: plan-change-preview
items.title: Plan change preview
items.description: Compact plan change summary card with side-by-side plan comparison, proration breakdown, upgrade/downgrade badge, discount, scheduled change warning, and optional confirm/cancel actions. Decision-support view for plan change flows.

items.name: plan-change-breakdown
items.title: Plan change breakdown
items.description: Detailed financial breakdown of a subscription plan change. Invoice-style view with per-transaction line items, proration periods, tax, credits, and totals for immediate, next, and recurring billing. Financial-transparency view complementing the compact plan-change-preview.
